wagon.title: Wagon search

meta.title: Where is the wagon · YukSaroy
meta.description: Enter a wagon number: which station it is at now, loaded or empty, and when it last moved.

wagon.lead: Enter a wagon number: which station it is at now, loaded or empty, and when it last moved.
wagon.note: Data comes from railway reports and is updated a few times a day. The first search is free, the rest need a subscription.
wagon.label: Wagon number
wagon.hint: 7 or 8 digits, written on the side of the wagon.
wagon.guest: Sign in to search. The first search is free.
wagon.subscribe: Your free search is used up. Unlimited searches need a subscription.
wagon.notFound: Wagon {no} is not in the latest reports. Check the number and try again.

errors.WAGON_NO_INVALID: The number must have 7 or 8 digits.
errors.WAGON_NOT_CONFIGURED: Wagon search is not connected yet. It will be available soon.
errors.WAGON_UPSTREAM: The data source did not respond. Try again in a little while.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many searches. You can continue in an hour.
